description: Play ViZDoom's defend_the_center scenario: you stand in the middle of a round room while melee monsters approach from all sides. Each kill earns 1 and dying costs 1. Ammo is limited (variable AMMO2), so only fire when a monster is centered (x near 0). Each step the graph receives an observation, and its label output is the next action. In the observation, objects lists what is visible: x is the object's horizontal screen position from -1 (left edge) to 1 (right edge), y is vertical from -1 (top) to 1 (bottom), and width and height are fractions of the screen, so nearer objects are larger. variables holds game variables. TURN_LEFT and TURN_RIGHT rotate the view; TURN_LEFT shifts objects right on screen by about 0.12 per action, and TURN_RIGHT shifts them left. A label joining buttons with + presses them together.
